title: Beechwood Road over Little Blue River
source_note: Source references are printed sheet numbers; PDF page = printed sheet + 1 for all referenced structural sheets.
method: Independent human-readable drawing extraction and deterministic parametric mesh construction; no LLM API or ontology pipeline.
native_axes: X station increasing; Y transverse left; Z up; station 104+96 at X=0; elevation 390 ft at Z=0
glb_axes: glTF Y-up: (X, Z, -Y) from native coordinates
assumptions: Exterior detail revision 2.0. The proposed three-span bridge is reconstructed independently from project sheets and the September 2022 INDOT standard-drawing archive. Internal reinforcing bars, prestressing strands and embedded studs are excluded.

Drawing dimensions, derived fits and selected product envelopes are distinguished in every component and in the detail coverage register. This is not a claim that all manufacturer and fabrication details are known.

The final deck profile includes the last 13 ft within the 110 ft vertical curve. Residual girder camber is interpolated parabolically; haunches and bearing tapers fit this reconstructed chord, not an erection survey.

TFC sections, PW plates, channel clips, bolts, washers, sole plates, shear keys, joint fillers, casing, grooves, drip beads, sleeper slabs and approach lugs are separately inspectable. Small product dimensions not called out are explicit selections.

Pile shoes, delineator products, benchmark tablet, thrie-beam end connector shaping and drain fittings/routes require supplier or construction drawings for exact reproduction. Provisional items have their own metadata/layer.
Groove nominal dimensions use the 2022 INDOT revision; contract special provisions were not supplied. Sleeper lower thickness is inferred from the drawn overall reinforcement envelope and covers.

Piles and sockets use drawing design/estimated tips and minimum rock sockets, not as-built records. Steel casing is represented as a 3/4 in shell with the drawing 60 in diameter interpreted as its outside diameter.

Immediate riprap-bank geometry is approximate and hidden by default. Its footprint and rock arrangement are not surveyed topography. The complete adjacent road/utility works are outside this bridge model.

Colors distinguish parts. Surface treatments do not create fictitious thick layers. The model is for visual examination and drawing comparison, not construction quantities, fabrication or structural certification.
